en: Illustrated historic postcard showing elegant people in late‑19th‑century clothing strolling in a landscaped city park with a large ornate fountain labeled "Franz Joseph Brunnen" in the Stadtpark. To the right are inset views of a statue of a woman on a pedestal in a wooded area and a small decorative structure or shrine with a person looking at it, plus a tower in the background. Floral decorations and the title "Gruss aus Graz" appear in stylized script, and the lower part of the card is filled with handwritten purple ink text.
